surah.personality_title: Al-Ikhlas — The Diamond of Monotheism & The Absolute Refuge
surah.personality_summary: Absolute, foundational, ontological, equal to one-third of the Qur'an. The purest distilled definition of monotheism in scripture: Allah is One (Ahad), Allah is As-Samad (the Eternal Refuge needed by all, needing none), He neither begets nor is He begotten, and none can ever be co-equal to Him.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Ikhlaas (Sincerity) is the 112th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 4 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل هو الله احد

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He neither begets nor is born
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He begot no one nor was He begotten

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor is there to Him any equivalent
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No one is comparable to Him.’
